sourceFile: 15. BRS-161016 DT Report test TIP 883 repair to U844 same dimension (3D)   date 24.10.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but misgroups the main comparison and outcome conditions.
issues: Primary changed factor should be TIP 883 repair dimension versus TIP 844 normal, not before versus after repair.
Vision outcome mixes TIP 883, TIP 844, before-repair, and after-repair rows into invalid comparisons.
Function outcome should compare TIP 883 to TIP 844 normal and can be judged similar, not left ungrouped.
Measurement outcome is a header-derived artifact and should be removed or converted to defect-type details.
Duplicate sheets are double-counted without confirming they are separate runs.
correctionPlan: Set baseline to TIP 844 normal and changed condition to TIP 883 repair dimension.
Use before-repair and after-repair spot welding as subgroup conditions for the vision result.
Compare like-for-like vision rows: TIP 883 before vs TIP 844 before, and TIP 883 after vs TIP 844 after.
Group function rows 54 and 56 as the function defect comparison under the same factor.
Remove duplicate-sheet double counting unless the sheets are proven separate evidence.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until duplicates and like-for-like comparisons are fixed.
